instruction: Choose a suitable engineering drawing/CAD application available in the current Ubuntu environment. The task is to edit a DXF drawing, so select software that can reliably open, modify, and export DXF files. Open or import /home/user/Desktop/guih03_gearbox_gasket_seed.dxf. Draft the hard gearbox gasket in exact coordinates. On OUTLINE create the closed profile through (0,30), (30,0), (160,0), (190,30), (190,110), (160,140), (30,140), and (0,110). Add eight HOLE circles radius 5 at (30,30), (95,20), (160,30), (170,70), (160,110), (95,120), (30,110), and (20,70). Add CUT circles center (95,70) radius 38 and centers (65,70), (125,70) radius 6. Add CENTER axes (95,0)-(95,140) and (0,70)-(190,70). Add an HATCH fill for the gasket body and notes GEARBOX GASKET - 8X Ø10 and HATCH BODY, LEAVE ALL CUTOUTS OPEN. Save the result as /home/user/Desktop/guih03_gearbox_gasket_completed.dxf. Complete the work through an interactive graphical workflow and save/export the required DXF file to the exact Desktop path stated above. Do not generate the drawing with external scripts, command-line CAD generation, or by directly writing DXF entities programmatically.
